DCCC_identity_statement: Previous RAW final-R at own len-2 is SAME CURRENT physical EXIT beta. DCCC RAW entirely MISSES it. Its actual following word tick7/read8 first requires R at DCCC context62, an immutable repeated R. No minimum age or residual-only repair argument is used.
arbitrary_length_parse_proof: Write each ordinary word as maximal base-plus-C runs. VCCC/UCCC forbid >=3 Cs after V/U, using actual next M if needed. DCC followed D/V/U is forbidden by the three fixed conflicts. >=3 Cs after D is forbidden by the actual preceding RAW EXIT-bud conflict; this previous atom exists internally unless D is first, where it is a stated hypothesis. Because the factor ends at a BASE, a DCC run cannot be terminal, hence every D run has <=1 C. Thus each maximal run is exactly a chosen G8 packet, with identical real RAW cuts and actual M11 supply. No bounded-length enumeration is used.
source_U_invocation: For a selected fresh RAW U, every D has a real preceding RAW inside the factor. The first maximal run is ACTUAL U/UC/UCC and the ending base is an ACTUAL completed D/V/U G8 packet with the SAME final M11. The signed U-entry center-simplicity theorem applies to arbitrary actual complete entry field; an earlier foreign or unrelated history lies outside the factor and is not an extra required ancestry. Therefore the selected-U-to-ending-base atomic proxy is injective without assuming it before the conclusion.
